info.title: Strata API
info.description:
Everything the web app does goes through this API: automation systems (Companion / Stream Deck, broadcast controllers, scripts) have the same power as the UI.

**Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` (create one in *Users → API keys*), or the `strata_mv_session` cookie of the web app.

**Real time**: `GET /ws` (WebSocket) pushes `hello`, `project`, `projectDeleted`, `channels` and `channel` events, and accepts `{"type":"command","channelId":"main","command":{…}}`. `/ws?channel=<id>` follows one channel (HTML5 output pages; public when *public outputs* is on).

Units: frames are project frames; times are Unix milliseconds.

tags.name: Inputs
tags.description: The live inputs and what each one carries: container, programs and EPG, streams, pictures (GOP, timecode, captions, HDR), MPEG-TS tables and TR 101 290, HLS playlists, NDI and SDI details.

post.description:
The `secret` is returned **once**: use it as `Authorization: Bearer smv_…`. The key acts with the rights of its user (create a dedicated operator account for automation).

**Rights:** admin for any user; designers and operators for themselves.

Body `{"password": "…"}`: the admin's own password. Answers `{"secret": "smv_…"}`. Keys made before this version cannot be shown again (400). Wrong password: 403.

**Rights:** admin.

put.description:
Saves the designer's working copy (draft). The Operator, outputs and playout keep using the published version until it is published (`POST …/publish`), or pass `?publish=true` to publish at once.

A designer tab sends its `X-Strata-Client` id: the save is refused (409) when another tab holds the template's edit lock. Requests without that header (automation, API keys) are not locked out.

**Rights:** admin, designer.

409.description: Another designer holds the edit lock

delete.description:
Also removes its draft and rundown items. The last template of a project cannot be deleted (409).

**Rights:** admin, designer.

post.summary: Take or renew a template's edit lock
post.description:
One designer tab at a time edits a template. The lock lapses when not renewed for 45 s. `force` takes it over: the previous holder is told by a `lock` WebSocket event and switches to read only.

**Rights:** admin, designer.

**Rights:** admin, designer.

get.description:
Container and programs (names, EPG present / following), every stream (codec, profile and level, picture, colours and HDR, scan, audio layout, languages, subtitles, closed captions, data: SCTE-35, KLV, ID3, ANC), its pictures (I / P / B, GOP, timecode, side data), and by transport: MPEG-TS tables, PIDs and TR 101 290 checks (SRT, UDP, TCP are relayed and read continuously; HLS: its last segment), HLS playlists (variants, renditions, segments, keys, ad markers), NDI (format, metadata) and SDI (format, timecode, ancillary packets).

**Rights:** any signed-in user.

lang.description: Language of the interface ("en", "fr"); empty = the browser's.

theme.description: Colour theme of the interface ("dark", "light", "system"); empty = dark.

password.description: Required on creation (8+ characters); empty keeps the current one on edit.

layer.description: Stacking order (higher = in front); also the playout layer.

transition.description: sequential: the graphic on air goes out before the new one comes in; cut: replaced at once; fade: the new one comes in while the one on air fades out.

areas.description: Area of the zone by format id ("main", "9x16"…), in fractions of the frame; a designer guide.

zone.description: Zone id; empty = the template's zone.

Template.description: A graphic: timeline (frames), markers, data fields and layers. See web/src/engine/types.ts for the full layer model.

binding.description: Live value from a data source; replaces what the operator types while the source has a value at the path.

logic.description: Relations between values (node graph), evaluated every frame after animation and bindings. Node `type`: `layerProp` {layer, prop}, `textSize` {layer, metric: width|height|lines|chars}, `field` {key}, `constant` {value}, `math` {op: add|sub|mul|div|min|max|abs|round|floor|ceil; inputs a, b}, `clamp` {min, max; input in}, `condition` {cmp: gt|ge|lt|le|eq|ne|empty|notEmpty; inputs a, b, then, else}, `target` {layer, prop, mode: set|add|multiply; input in}. Edges connect a node's output to an input `port` of another node.

language.description: Language of the texts ("fr", "en", "de", "es", "it"): hyphenation, French spaces, and the day and month names of the Clock widgets that follow the project (`lang` "" on a clock layer).

renditions.description: Other pictures of the channel (9:16…), driven by the same takes; HTML5 at /output/<channel>/<rendition>.

slate.description: Still picture shown while no project is loaded ("" = none).

SlateStyle.description: What a channel picture shows while no project is loaded: a built-in design (Aurora, Bento, Gradient, Frame, Lines, Split: "Strata Multiview", the channel name, size, ratio and frame rate), `transparent` (nothing) or `custom`, its still picture (`slate`). Not set in the settings: `custom` when a still picture is set, else `aurora`.

age.description: Project frames on air since the take.

next.description: Take waiting for this graphic to go out (sequential zones).

clocks.description: Widgets controlled by the operator, by layer id: offset and pausedAt in frames on air.

layers.description: Playout layer (zone stacking order) → graphic on air.

Command.description: Target a zone by id (`zone`) or a raw playout layer (`layer`). A take without either plays in the template's zone; a clear without either clears everything. `trigger` (with `name`) applies to the whole channel.

target.description: widget: layer id or name of a timed widget (timer, stopwatch, ticker, roll, counter…), or `*` for all of them

control.description: widget: start (resume), pause, toggle, reset (to zero, keeps running or paused), restart (to zero and running)

name.description: trigger: resumes every graphic holding on a pause that waits for this trigger

dataset.description: row: key or name of a data set of the graphic on air

row.description: row: the row to show (1 = first); the graphic changes the way its data set says (out › in, crossfade or cut)

fade.description: update: the old values cross-fade out (½ s) instead of a cut

ServerConfig.description: config.json: name, bind, publicOutputs, timezone and channels (format, outputs, loaded project: `projectId`, null for none, kept as it is on air when settings are saved; `slate` and `slateStyle` (SlateStyle) of the main picture and of each rendition).

Format.description: Alternative layout of a project (the main one is the project's width × height, id "main"). Layers carry per-format overrides; each output uses the format closest to its aspect ratio.

V1ChannelStatus.description: What a control surface shows for a channel.

tally.description: `pgm` on air, `pvw` taken and waiting for its zone to clear, `cue` what `next` takes.

warnings.description: Rows (or values) of the data sources of its template that break their rules (a warning only: it can still be taken).

paused.description: Holding on a pause that waits for Continue or a trigger.

surfaces.description: Control surfaces connected (feedback sockets, TCP, OSC senders of the last minute)

control.description: The OSC and TCP listeners: `{osc: {enabled, port}, tcp: {enabled, port}}`.

action.description: take, out, continue, update, clear, row, widget, trigger
